title: VIRTUAL FASHION GALLERY
tagline: VFG is a space created with augmented & virtual reality that provides a virtual environment where artists exhibit their art, allowing users to interact with pieces based on immersive technology.
description:
Virtual Fashion Gallery (VFG) provides a new perspective to explore and use the art, teamed up artists, producers, designers, managers and other kind of creators to show how virtual & augmented reality expands the innovation and experiences for users and collectors.

With an intuitive interface, easy-to-use in a virtual environment, VFG uploads the creations to the web and explore art using your mobile phone to discover a series of new artworks from artists in the real life from the comfort of your house. This means that you can see the latest exhibit at your home using internet.

Artists and creators stay connected with their audiences, creating new experiences using immersive or extended technologies (XR) allowing users can go and look around to interact with augmented & virtual art (VR/AR).

In Our digital environment people can walk and interact with the space with software that facilitate animating 3D art in real time by manipulating objects in physical space, providing a mobile, user-friendly experience.

In VFG art is exhibited creating experiences and providing a collection of works from the artists  to be displayed in AR/VR in their own homes to interact more naturally with art

Artists are able to curate their own gallery experience, showcase their work and interact with the audience directly. The Audiences can personalize their own art exhibits and share or set as they want.

New virtual spaces emerges to see some of the world's best art all from inside your own home, where users experience performance their pieces creating virtual experiences using augmented & virtual reality through your phone camera.
how_its_made:
This project uses 2D graphic design software, and Virtual and Augmented Virtual Reality software and Hardware.  



At first, we buy a model of a  3D purse on CGtrader. Then we create a 2D original design in Procreate, After the graphic piece is finished, we continue the process in Virtual Reality. On the Oculus Quest 2, we import the graphic image into Gravity Sketch, where we use that image as a material for the 3D purse. We use 3D tools to modify the original purse, to give it the style we are looking for. Then we export that 3D asset as an obj file, this file is used in two ways. The first one is for Augmented Reality and the other to create the NFT in VR.



For the augmented reality experience, we import the 3D asset in Spark AR, Facebook's software to create AR filters for Instagram. For VR we import the 3D asset to Tilt Brush, Google's open-source painting VR software where we create the final NFT. 



After having that pieces, on Frame VR we create a Virtual 360 Gallery for the exhibition. This VR gallery can be accessed through web browsers on PC or mobile.



Also, We are the first 3 Colombians who mints NFT's using Virtual & Augmented reality. We created our username (VirtualFashionGallery ) on OpenSea platform to mint two unique & exclusive NFT's based on AR/VR that provides a new perspective to explore art using AR/VR in a virtual environment where artists exhibit their art.



 First, we created a Collection called "Immersive Handbags Collection", (IHC) is an explosion of creativity, art, designs and full-colors. In this collection you will find 2 unique & exclusive handbags in NFT's format using Augmented & Virtual Reality (AR/VR). Also, purchasing these handbags you'll be allowed to explore a new virtual environment in our virtual fashion gallery (VFG) where these pieces will be exhibited infinitely using immersive technology. You can share and show your acquisition anytime, anywhere with everybody in an exclusive and intuitive room for 20 people simultaneously with chat, video and voice that makes this experience unique in the world. There is a QR code assigned to each handbag exposed in the virtual fashion gallery, scanning it you'll be allowed to use a story filter for your Instagram using augmented reality (AR) to interact with it showing the art on your screen and in the real-world environment using your phone to share it with the world.



1st NFT "RainBowie" is a magic handbag with an explosion of full color and texture where you can keep your NFT's. It reminds us the concept of crypto-wallet. Existing in a virtual world connected with real-world environment through Augmented & Virtual reality (AR/VR).
